cases.title: Build a multi-step interactive dashboard

input.request: Create a responsive React/TypeScript dashboard with filters, shared state, loading/empty/error states, and clear acceptance checks.

success_criteria: State ownership and component boundaries are explicit
Core filters update the visible result set and are keyboard operable
Responsive and failure states are specified and verified or marked not-run

human_review_rubric: evidence directly supports each claimed result
